task: binary classification of peptides as TIP (positive) vs non-TIP; P(TIP) in [0, 1], called TIP at >= 0.5. TIP is most likely tyrosinase inhibitory peptide, unconfirmed in the source data
architecture: equal-weight soft-voting ensemble of RandomForest (500 trees, depth 10, leaf 3), XGBoost (300 trees, depth 3, lr 0.05), sigmoid-calibrated RBF SVC (C=10, gamma=0.001, scaled) and shrinkage LDA (lsqr, shrinkage 0.5, scaled)
esm_embedding: mean-pooled last_hidden_state over residue positions, BOS/EOS excluded
weights_layout: ensemble.joblib (dict: ensemble, embedding_metadata, threshold, classes, seed, feature_dimension), run_metadata.json

training_data.split: stratified random 80/20 (566 train / 142 test), seed 42; hyperparameters tuned by 5-fold CV AUC on train only; model not refit on the test set

test_metrics.caveat: random split, so homologous peptides may span train and test; does not show generalization to unrelated families
